text: Deep Learning (DL) has transformed cardiac image segmentation, yet its application to congenital heart disease (CHD) remains underexplored, with no prior systematic review in this emerging domain. This review evaluates current DL approaches for CHD CT segmentation, identifies best performing model architectures, assesses quality of reporting and highlights challenges for clinical implementation.
source_label: Deep learning for cardiac CT segmentation for congenital heart disease: A systematic review
